A: A preserves the exact J0.6 baseline and prior regressions
B: B invokes a tool through provider-neutral J0.7 contracts
C: C requires explicit registered tool identity and version
D: D rejects invalid input and malformed output
E: E denies execution before adapter dispatch when J0.3 authorization rejects
F: F binds authorization to exact normalized input and rejects alteration
G: G keeps model proposals isolated from adapters and credentials
H: H enforces delegated actor scope through the authorization boundary
I: I denies forbidden external data egress including D5/local-only data
J: J brokers credentials only at dispatch and redacts them from results and audit
K: K simulates or dry-runs without mutation or implicit execution authority
L: L prevents duplicate effects and rejects idempotency key conflicts
M: M enforces deadlines and truthful cancellation semantics
N: N bounds retries and never blindly retries unsafe mutation
O: O treats timeout after possible mutation as UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and reconciles
P: P separates provider success from independent verification
Q: Q revalidates emergency and authorization state immediately before dispatch
R: R treats tool output and prompt injection as untrusted data without authority
S: S emits safe deterministic audit and provenance without secret leakage
T: T runs the complete universal gateway path with verification, reconciliation and provider-independent authority
